environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment in CI/CD cluster with identical pod spec and preStop lifecycle hook. Database connection uses PostgreSQL role 'pipeline_ro' which was provisioned via Vault database secrets engine with a TTL-bound lease. The role is created from a template that executes: CREATE ROLE "{{name}}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO "{{name}}"; The Vault mount configuration at database/roles/pipeline-readonly has 'creation_statements' locked to SELECT-only grants with no additional default_ttl override. The pg_hba.conf entry for the subnet restricts this role family (prefix 'v-pipeline-ro-') to connections from the pod CIDR only.

config.vault_creation_statements: CREATE ROLE "{{name}}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO "{{name}}";
